newsitem.title: TURKEY: Five troops, 19 rebels killed in Turk southeast.
newsitem.headline: Five troops, 19 rebels killed in Turk southeast.

text.p: Turkish security forces killed 19 rebels of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) in clashes on Sunday in which five security force members were also killed, the emergency rule governor's office said.

Troops killed 14 of the rebels in fighting in Siirt province where the five Turkish security force members also died. Three rebels were killed in Bingol province and another two in Hakkari, the governor's office, based in Diyarbakir, said.
More than 22,000 people have died in the 12-year conflict between the security forces and the PKK who are fighting for independence or autonomy in the mainly Kurdish southeast of Turkey.
